explanations_and_examples.example: He backed away from the edge, looking all around at the flat horizon.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (fml.) relating to the body, rather than to the mind, feelings, or spirit 身体的；肉体的
explanations_and_examples.example: And then there is our own body, our own corporeal instrument, which we're awfully proud of.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C, U] an unusual, exciting, or impressive event or sight 壮观的景象；奇观
explanations_and_examples.example: Watching a lion chasing its prey is one of nature's most exciting spectacles.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: move slowly on water or in the air 漂流；飘动
explanations_and_examples.example: I looked up at the clouds floating in the sky.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: dark purple-red in color 深红色的；绯红色的
explanations_and_examples.example: They walked past fields with huge sprays of crimson, yellow and purple flowers.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (partook, partaken) (fml.) take part in an activity or event 参加；参与
explanations_and_examples.example: Retailers who partake in the campaign should place a sticker on their window.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: a complete change into sb. / sth. very different, or the process during which this happens 彻底改观；变化过程
explanations_and_examples.example: After three weeks, we noticed a total transformation in his behavior and attitude.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [U] the quality of being very pleasant or attractive 迷人；魅力
explanations_and_examples.example: As the mountain path spirals up, the beauty of the scene fills each of us with enchantment.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: become bigger and wider, or make sth. do this （使）膨胀；（使）扩大
explanations_and_examples.example: Red wine can help to dilate blood vessels.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: secretly plan with sb. to do sth. bad or illal 搞阴谋；密谋
explanations_and_examples.example: The company is accused of conspiring with three other local stores to fix prices.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: treat sb. / sth. with extreme respect and admiration 崇拜；把···神化；把···奉若神明
explanations_and_examples.example: We are inclined to deify successful people, and in our time that certainly includes CEOs.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [U] formal ceremony, esp. involving expensive clothes, special traditions, etc. 华典；盛典；盛况
explanations_and_examples.example: She arrived at the airport without the pomp that usually accompanies important politicians.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] (also faery) a fairy 仙子；小精灵
(also mystical) involving religious, spiritual, or magical powers that people cannot understand 神奇的；神秘的
explanations_and_examples.example: He has undergone a profound mystic experience over the past two months.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [U] the tendency to be easily affected or influenced by sth. 易受影响（或感染）的倾向；敏感性
explanations_and_examples.example: One of the side effects of the drug is an increased susceptibility to infection.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] a small thin piece that breaks away easily from sth. else 小薄片
explanations_and_examples.example: Toward the middle of the night, large flakes of snow ban to fall swiftly.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (fml.) change sth., esp. in order to achieve a particular effect 改变；调整
explanations_and_examples.example: Teachers modulate the way they work in response to their students' needs.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] a small amount of a particular color 浅色；淡色调
explanations_and_examples.example: Green has many different shades and tints.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [U] a calm or relaxed state 安详；休息
explanations_and_examples.example: The atmosphere in the hall is one of repose rather than excitement.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] 磨坊
[C] （教堂或其他建筑物的）尖顶
(also calyx) (pl. calices) 花萼
[U] （庄稼收割后遗留的）残株，茬
cover sth. with frost 使···蒙上白霜
explanations_and_examples.example: He does not brush away the frost that rimes his beard.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: not speaking, or not willing to speak 缄默的；无声的
explanations_and_examples.example: Marianna, the king's daughter, became mute after a shock.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: friendly and kind 友好的；善良的
explanations_and_examples.example: He was a warm-hearted friend and genial host, liked by everyone he met.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (beheld, beheld) see sth. 看；看见
explanations_and_examples.example: He looked up and beheld a stranger sitting across the table, smiling a secret smile.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: 1) great beauty 壮丽；灿烂
explanations_and_examples.example: It will cost millions of pounds to restore the castle into its former glory.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: 2) admiration and praise that you get because you have done sth. impressive 荣誉；光荣
explanations_and_examples.example: It will cost millions of pounds to restore the castle into its former glory.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [U] darkness in which it is difficult to see clearly 昏暗
explanations_and_examples.example: She peered into the gloom, but she couldn't see where the noise was coming from.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: make sb. / sth. different 使变样；改变
explanations_and_examples.example: This doesn't alter the fact that what you did was wrong. You'd better call him and apologize.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [sing.] a series of people or things of the same type 一连串，一系列（同类型的人或物）
explanations_and_examples.example: I can't understand why after graduation he took a succession of low-paid jobs.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C, U] 牧场
1) a group of related animals or plants （动植物的）族，群
explanations_and_examples.example: They didn't quite expect that this tribe of cats could give them so much trouble.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: 2) a social group consisting of people of the same race who have the same beliefs, language, etc. and usually live in one particular area ruled by their leader 部落
explanations_and_examples.example: They didn't quite expect that this tribe of cats could give them so much trouble.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: arriving or happening at the time agreed on 按时的；准时的
explanations_and_examples.example: She's always very punctual for appointments and because of this she is highly respected.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] 河道；溪流
[C, U] 梭鱼草
[C, U] 小狗鱼草
(of trees or plants) produce flower 开花
explanations_and_examples.example: Most roses will bin to bloom from late May and the garden will be at its best.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (of people, animals, etc.) move around in a large group （人、动物等）成群地来回移动
explanations_and_examples.example: Every day tourists swarm through the narrow streets of the old city.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: continuing all the time 长期的；永恒的
explanations_and_examples.example: I thought her perpetual complaints were going to prove too much for me.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] a special performance or event to celebrate sth. 特别演出；欢庆活动；庆典
explanations_and_examples.example: We ate dinner and watched the Spring Festival Gala together on New Year's Eve.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] a small attractive object used for decoration or for making sb. / sth. more beautiful 装饰品；点缀品
explanations_and_examples.example: I guessed he was the chief because he wore more gold ornaments than the others.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: wet with drops of dew 带露水的
explanations_and_examples.example: The grass was dewy, the apples green, but already fragrant

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] 果园
[C, U] a flower on a tree, or all the flowers on a tree （一棵树上的）花，全部花朵
explanations_and_examples.example: Rain bins to fall and peach trees are in blossom.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (fml.) laugh at sb. / sth. in an unkind way, esp. by copying what they say or do 嘲弄；（通过模仿）取笑
explanations_and_examples.example: The other children mocked the girl's French accent, laughing behind their hands.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: used to emphasize how small or unimportant sb. / sth. is 仅仅的，只不过（用于强调小或微不足道）
explanations_and_examples.example: We don't consider our customers to be mere consumers; we consider them to be our friends.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [U] （装饰用的）闪光纸
shine with a soft light that looks as if it shakes slightly 发微光；闪闪发亮
explanations_and_examples.example: My thoughts shimmer with the shimmering leaves and my heart sings with the touch of this sunlight.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: hold sth. tightly because one does not want to lose it 紧握；紧抓
explanations_and_examples.example: The young man stood in the doorway, his invitation clutched tightly in his hand.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] an effect caused by hot air in deserts, at sea, or on roads, which makes you think that you can see objects when they are not actually there 幻景；海市蜃楼
explanations_and_examples.example: She thought at first it must be the edge of an oasis, then realized it was a mirage.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: (fml.) the attitude or behavior of sb. who works very hard and very carefully 勤奋；用功
explanations_and_examples.example: We should cultivate the good habits of diligence and frugality

explanations_and_examples.explanation: [C] a sign that sth. is soon going to happen 预兆
explanations_and_examples.example: If this first opera of the season is a herald of what is to come, we can expect great things.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: 1) felt or experienced in your own mind but not expressed to other people 内心的；精神的
explanations_and_examples.example: She watched his expression, saw the relaxation of his features, and breathed an inward sigh of relief.

explanations_and_examples.explanation: 2) toward the inside or center of sth. 向内的；向中心的
explanations_and_examples.example: She watched his expression, saw the relaxation of his features, and breathed an inward sigh of relief.
